build.beforeDevCommand: npm run icons:install && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run icons:install && npm run icons:app && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: AI-first text editor and local-first knowledge base
bundle.longDescription: MCPad is a fast, cross platform text editor and local-first knowledge base with a built-in MCP server, native voice dictation and .canvas boards.
